text: | **Fail-open** | New `AdUrlState` enum with a first-class `ResolutionFailed` terminal state. Today's embed machinery only models "not-yet / resolved" (waits forever) — wrong here, since *most URLs are just URLs*. The link must render immediately; resolution is a non-blocking upgrade. | [...] - nmp-content: Segment::AdCandidateUrl + WireNode::AdCandidateUrl (fbs WireNodeKind=22 appended; bindings regen'd via ci/regenerate-flatbuffers.sh; goldens+SegmentDto regen'd). Every plain http(s) URL now tokenizes to it. AdUrlResolver capability + AdUrlState fail-open state (NotAttempted/Resolving/ResolutionFailed{at}/Resolved{projection_key}).
